title: private-deployment-aurora-weekly-sync-2026-03-02
content:
Weekly sync prep / notes - Private deployment: Aurora
Date: 2026-03-02
Owner / note-taker: Priya Patel
Attendees (expected): Priya, Marcus, Elena, Rajesh, Tom, Aurora (customer) - infra lead

Goal for this sync: align on VPC peering progress, on-prem install checklist, outstanding security items, and lift blockers for staging rollout (target: 2026-03-09).

Agenda:
- Quick status round (2m each)
- Networking / VPC and connectivity (Marcus)
- On-prem deployment & installer (Elena)
- Secrets / KMS & Audit (Rajesh)
- Load testing / perf plan for staging (Tom)
- Blockers & owners / next steps

Status summaries (quick bullets)
1) Networking / VPC
- Current: Aurora confirmed CIDR ranges, we have inbound rules doc (Confluence) updated 2026-03-01.
- Peering: Partial. Customer-side peering established, routing table not yet propagated in customer firewall (waiting on Aurora infra team).
- Tested: BGP session attempts failing intermittently (see PD-412).
- Risk: Until routing fully propagates, cannot run end-to-end deployment to staging.
- Owner / action: Marcus to escalate with Aurora infra today; ask for firewall admin contact and expected ETA. (Owner: Marcus; ETA: 2026-03-04)

2) On-prem installer & infra provisioning
- Current: Installer v0.8 packaged and smoke-tested in our lab.
- Customer env specifics: air-gapped nodes for model-serving; requires offline bundle + pre-shared container images.
- Outstanding: Offline image transfer instructions missing step for checksum verification; installer fails at image import on RHEL8 (error: loopback mount permission).
- Owner / action: Elena to update installer doc and add checklist for offline bundle (including checksums, SELinux note). Coordinate with Aurora SRE for one test import next week. (Owner: Elena; ETA: 2026-03-06)

3) Secrets / KMS and compliance
- Current: Aurora uses AWS KMS in their account. They requested support for key rotation policy and customer-managed CMKs.
- Outstanding: IAM policy to allow cross-account decrypt not finalized; audit log forwarding plan needs confirmation.
- Security review: Rajesh ran initial review; noted that our agent needs explicit MFA bypass exemption documented for initial bootstrap (risk: small but need signoff).
- Owner / action: Rajesh to draft minimal IAM policy and rotation guidance; schedule 30m call with Aurora security for Wednesday. (Owner: Rajesh; ETA: 2026-03-04)

4) Load testing / perf plan for staging
- Current: Test harness ready; default profile uses 4 concurrent connections / 1k tokens per min.
- Need: Representative workload from Aurora (they agreed to provide sample request traces).
- Outstanding: KV cache behavior under simulated long-tail seen in our lab; may require tuning of cache TTLs.
- Owner / action: Tom to start baseline run once peering is fixed; coordinate with Marcus for network window. (Owner: Tom; ETA: conditional on peering)

Blockers (summary)
- Primary blocker: Routing propagation / firewall rules on Aurora side preventing end-to-end testing. (Blocker -> Marcus / Aurora infra)
- Secondary blocker: Installer offline import failure on RHEL8 (Blocker -> Elena)
- Tertiary: IAM/KMS policy signoff (Blocker -> Rajesh / Aurora security)

Decisions / proposals for today's sync
- Proposal A: If routing not completed by 2026-03-04, run a controlled test using our lab with peered test VPC that mirrors Aurora config to begin perf testing. Pros: saves time; Cons: not a full fidelity test for customer network.
- Proposal B: Delay staging rollout until routing confirmed; use the extra week to harden installer and docs.
- We'll decide in meeting after hearing Aurora infra ETA.

Action items (tracking)
- Marcus: Get firewall admin contact and escalate routing propagation with Aurora; post update in Slack. (due 2026-03-04)
- Elena: Update installer offline bundle doc with checksum step and SELinux note; test import on RHEL8 and report logs. (due 2026-03-06)
- Rajesh: Draft IAM cross-account policy for KMS access + rotation notes; set 30m security call with Aurora. (due 2026-03-04)
- Tom: Prepare perf harness and baseline scripts; stand by to run once network available. (due 2026-03-05, conditional)
- Priya: Draft email to Aurora CISO summarizing bootstrap plan and the temporary mitigations; schedule next sync for 2026-03-09. (due 2026-03-03)
- Aurora infra lead: Provide firewall rule propagation ETA and confirm whether they can run the test import with our guidance. (requested 2026-03-04)

Notes to self / open questions
- Confirm whether Aurora's air-gapped nodes have local proxy for auth. If not, need alternative for image verification.
- Should we bundle an alternate RPM to handle loopback mount permission workarounds on RHEL8? Check security implications.
- Track cost implications for an extra staging week (flag to sales if needed).

Meeting prep checklist (for call)
- Share latest installer doc link at start of call (Elena)
- Have Marcus share peering status screenshot / traceroute outputs
- Rajesh to have IAM policy draft ready to screen-share
- Tom to have test harness README open

Post-meeting follow-up template (copy into Slack / email)
- Quick summary of decisions + owners + due dates (one-paragraph)
- Attach relevant artifacts (Confluence links, logs)
- Ask Aurora for clear ETA on firewall/routing by EOD

Last saved: quick local notes and logs attached in Confluence link (linked_artifacts).

-- end --
